purpose: Predeclared external development stress tests; not independent final testing
mask_policy: Per sequence seeded contiguous intervals until ceil(fraction*length) rows are masked; final interval can be truncated. Existing missingness is preserved. Report actual missing fraction.
crowd_policy: Start probability proportional to 1+crowd_weight when at least crowd_min_players observed within crowd_radius_m of observed ball; proxy only, never target-conditioned.
duplicate_policy: Append ceil(fraction*roster_slots) sampled slots independently per team; copies share source coordinates and missingness before optional dropout/noise.
control: Logistic dead probability plus smoothed/propagated reference owner converted to H/A/D emissions, then neural decoder penalty 5. This is a decoding control, not identical or calibrated neural emissions.
